# Introduction {.unnumbered}

**Unit 3: Using AI Well**

The heart of the class. You will learn how to ask AI good questions. You will use it to help with writing, research, translation, math, and art.

Then you will finish a real project that uses AI to do something useful in your life. We will have time to get feedback, make it better, and do the work right.

***

## What You'll Learn

By the end of this unit, you will be able to:

* Write clear prompts and make them better
* Use AI to help with writing, research, translation, math, and art
* Check AI's work before you use it
* Use AI honestly in school
* Finish a real project that uses AI to solve a problem in your life

***

## Topics in This Unit

[**Asking Good Questions**](3.1_Asking_Good_Questions.qmd)\
The three parts of a good prompt: task, context, and format.

[**Keep Talking**](3.2_Keep_Talking.qmd)\
Follow-up questions turn a bad answer into a useful one.

[**Writing with AI, Not by AI**](3.3_Writing_with_AI.qmd)\
The AI use ladder, and feedback you control.

[**Research and Checking**](3.4_Research_and_Checking.qmd)\
Why chatbots make things up, and how fact-checkers check.

[**AI and Your Language**](3.5_AI_and_Your_Language.qmd)\
You are the expert: grade AI translations in your language.

[**AI and Math**](3.6_AI_and_Math.qmd)\
Rules and predictions, and three ways to check an AI's math.

[**Making Pictures with AI**](3.7_Making_Pictures_with_AI.qmd)\
From noise to picture: how image generators work.

[**Project: Solve a Real Problem**](3.8_Project_Solve_a_Real_Problem.qmd)\
Plan and start a project that uses AI to help in your life.

[**Project: Feedback and Share**](3.9_Project_Feedback_and_Share.qmd)\
Give and get feedback in a gallery walk, then choose what to change.
